Hi Tessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to move forward with the private offer but need to lock the drawdown cadence and confirm how co-sell attribution will appear in the GCP Marketplace (Acme's procurement needs this for internal reporting).

Attached is the signed PO (stub) and a quick note from our contracts team calling out a preferred monthly burn schedule (see attachment). Can you confirm:
- Is the marketplace private-offer redemption window configurable per-sku?
- How will co-sell attribution be surfaced to both Acme and Redwood for pipeline & crediting purposes?
- Do you support staggered drawdown for the first two quarters if we accelerate consumption later?

We'd like a short ops handoff call with your billing/partnership team this week. Available windows: Wed 9/15 10–12 PT or Thu 9/16 13–15 PT.

Thanks,
Jared

Head of Procurement, Acme Retail

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: private offer details & co-sell routing

Hi Jared —

Appreciate the PO and the clear asks. High level answers up front, then proposed next steps:

- Marketplace redemption window: yes, GCP private offers allow per-sku redemption rules. We can set phased SKU availability for Q1/Q2 to enable staggered drawdowns.
- Co-sell attribution: we surface co-sell registration + marketplace redemption in our partner dashboard and push a structured event to the Marketplace reporting so both parties can reconcile. We typically run a weekly reconciliation for the first 60 days.
- Staggered drawdown: supported. We recommend a two-stage commit (initial reserve + ramp) to avoid front-loading invoices.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Ops handoff call to confirm SKUs and set redemption windows — Ben and Marissa will own.
2) Ben to circulate a draft drawdown schedule (xlsx) for Acme to mark preferred months.
3) Priya (Cloudscale) — if you can confirm the marketplace listing mapping and any required partner metadata before the call that will speed things up.

Wed 9/15 10:30 PT works for us — would that fit Acme? Call invite to follow.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Jared —

Uploading an initial burn/drawdown plan attached (po-burn-plan.xlsx). Key notes in the sheet:
- Split commit into: 40% Q4 2026, 30% Q1 2027, 30% Q2 2027 (can be adjusted).
- SKU-level gating: we'll gate new SKU redemptions to the Q1 bucket; core SKU available immediately.
- Invoice timing: GCP issues monthly invoices; we will map redemptions to invoice periods and provide an accrual report weekly.

Operational questions for Acme:
- Do you require front-loaded invoicing for budget reasons? If so, we can propose a staged billing schedule.
- Who should receive the weekly reconciliation reports?

I'll prep the ops deck for Wed 9/15 and circulate before the call.

Ben Carter
Sr. Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
